system.notes:
A two-person submarine for underwater exploration, retrieval and rescue, working down to 900 m on 50 man-hours of independent air. Swivel-mount lamps and an extendible claw (a poor weapon, but it loads the isolated cargo hold underwater).

  • Signature 6/7: Sonar Signature 7. Sonar 1. Depth: 900 meters.
  • Entry: 1 hatch. Fuel: diesel/electric (300 liters/250 PF). Economy: 1 km/liter; 1 km/PF.
  • Other: enviroseal (water and engine), life support (10 man-hours), mechanical claw arm (Strength 16).
  • The claw follows the mechanical arm rules (Rigger 2 p.34), but the operator takes +3 on all Success Tests for its clumsy design.

source.cell: Saeder-Krupp D. J. Locker stat block
